issues.before: l'interdiction de lire est une défense ouverte
issues.after: l'interdiction de lire est une interdiction publique
issues.source_issue: 中文是公开的禁令，不是开放的防御。保其作为锁定而非殖民的分类依据，避免把禁止读写说成防御。

issues.before: Seuls restent hors de l'échelle les actes qui ne mobilisent aucune réponse de volonté, de personne.
issues.after: Seuls restent hors de l'échelle les actes qui ne s'appuient sur aucune réponse venant de la volonté d'une personne.
issues.source_issue: 原指不取用任何人的意志回应才在域外；réponse de volonté, de personne搭配与末逗号不自然，读者难辨谁的意志/回应。改完整自然限定，不添自愿或独立同意标准。

issues.before: « Pouvoir s'arrêter et ne pas cesser, voilà l'autonomie »
issues.after: « On ne peut parler d'autonomie que si l'on peut s'arrêter et que l'on continue néanmoins »
issues.source_issue: ‘能停而不辍，才是自律’给必要条件；原voilà将其读成充分认证，与本篇09–10明说能停不辍仍可执迷冲突。保only-if，不改旧引后面马达一半。

issues.before: **Nommer une rubrique, pas condamner une personne.**
issues.source_issue: 原点名栏位、不点名人，比‘可以点人但不要定罪’更明确地限制诊断对象。后文已另讲不猜居心/罪责，不能以不定罪替代本条操作与人的区分。

issues.before: statut normatif non méritocratique de chaque personne
issues.after: statut normatif de chaque personne, indépendant de ses mérites
issues.source_issue: 非功绩性说目的地位不靠个人功绩取得，不是讨论政体是否为贤能统治；indépendant de ses mérites自然精确，避免méritocratique制度含义。

issues.before: ne pas agir intentionnellement et ne pas tailler
issues.after: pratiquer le non-agir et ne pas tailler
issues.source_issue: 旧引‘无为而不凿’不能加成不作有意的行动，后者引入动机/意图标准。用通常的non-agir保原概念，不擅自补定义。

issues.before: Ses actions ne retirent pas cette présomption ; on peut juger ses opérations.
issues.after: Il ne retire pas non plus cette présomption en raison des actes de l'autre ; il peut juger ses opérations.
issues.source_issue: 原是承者的法不因他人的行为而撤目的默认，不是‘他的动作自动不撤默认’这一描述。明确承者为撤/不撤主语、他行为为不可据以撤回理由，仍只可判操作。

issues.before: si l'on veut la solidité du compte et un gain effectivement acquis
issues.after: si l'on veut un compte solide et accroître ce que l'on obtient effectivement
issues.source_issue: 原条件为账目成色与‘实得之增’，不只是取得某个真实收益；保增长这一条件并用自然动词句。

issues.before: Le droit de refuser l'adoption n'est pas réduit.
issues.after: La possibilité de refuser l'adoption reste entière.
issues.source_issue: 原‘承可拒不打折扣’保一个可拒的选择，不在此推出另一个法权意义的权利；用possibilité避免增补droit，承前两类地位/认/承区分。

issues.before: pas une décision prise à la place des faits sur la sortie effective d'une personne.
issues.after: pas un verdict sur la sortie effective d'une personne.
issues.source_issue: 原三禁线不代判事实上是否已退场；‘替事实作决定’法语不自然，事实并非能被代理的判定者。改为不据三禁线替实际退场下断语，不添加新标准。

issues.before: le versant positif de la culture d'autrui
issues.after: le versant positif du soutien au développement d'autrui
issues.source_issue: 涵育指支持他人成为自己；culture d'autrui易读成给别人灌输文化或文化背景，和反殖民段意向相反。用自然支持他人发展的表达，仍明确此积极面尚待证成，不由薄前提推出。

issues.before: Même ce qu'il peut dire ne lui donne aucun titre à légiférer pour lui.
issues.after: Même ce que le livre peut dire ne lui donne aucun titre à légiférer à la place de cette personne.
issues.source_issue: 原‘这些说得出的更不取得替他立法资格’两个主体为本书与对方；il/lui/lui连用与pour lui易让读者失去代谁立法的区分，明确书不因此能替对方立法。

issues.before: la loi du refusant n'arrête pas
issues.after: la loi de celui qui refuse cette proposition n'arrête pas
issues.source_issue: refusant名词化不自然；明确为拒此书提议/本支法者，其自己的法未拦住害人部分，不扩大成拒全部SAE或泛指一切拒绝。

metadata_issues.source_issue: 原导语列‘今站’，正文为用昔日声誉未经复审裁今日、以及今日代签明日。不能把此诊断名称改成过去位置；本篇正文已有正确方向。

metadata_review: Only ep07–ep12 article-specific title/deck/kicker/source_note were reviewed here. Full series/UI review and the first six articles are not claimed; these are assigned to other non-authors.
quality_conclusion: All six saved essays are complete flowing reader prose, not outlines or compressed notes. No wholesale rewrite needed. Older claims remain objects of examination rather than silently corrected; unproved bridges and unverified candidate configurations remain unproved; negative diagnosis and direction report, time/domain operation not identity, limited availability, no disposal permission, no automatic institutional legitimacy, and disagreement not refuted by this branch remain explicit. The local findings concern a prohibition mistranslated as defence, only-if, person/object scope, normative agency, term precision and a few unclear French constructions.
actual_source_read: Current canonical Chinese ep07–ep12 was actually reread in addition to prior full authorship reading. One oversized tool output truncated ep09[19] through ep10[0–6]; all those omitted units were then extracted and actually read in a separate complete output.

actual_scope.finding: Read the entire paragraph: public prohibition, not open defence; the distinction between locking, colonization and intrusion remains.

Read the entire paragraph: the new complete sentence naturally limits the outside-domain case to acts using no response from a person's will, without introducing voluntary-consent requirements; sensory clues, belief, killing and sleep examples remain.

Read the entire paragraph: the lead's final Il n'y a autonomie que si l'on peut s'arrêter et que l'on continue retains only-if, not sufficient certification. Position-indexed incompatibility and case-by-case departure remain separate.
Read the entire paragraph: name a rubric rather than a person, beyond the separate no-culpability/no-mindreading constraints; first-person ownership remains ungrantable and unrevokable by others.

The first full readback found that indépendant de ses mérites dans son domaine could attach the domain to merits rather than the object-domain. This was reported, not passed. After the lead saved le statut normatif, indépendant des mérites, de chaque personne appartenant au domaine considéré, I actually reread the whole saved paragraph. The object-domain restriction and non-merit-dependent status are now unambiguous; the status/attitude gap remains explicitly unbridged.
Read the entire paragraph: non-agir does not add an intentionality test; all alternative branches and the exception for the denier's contradictory sentence remain.

Read the entire paragraph: the adopter is now clearly the agent who does not withdraw the default treatment because of the other's acts; only operations are judged. Costs of staying and leaving both remain.
Read the entire paragraph: actual-gain increase, the open external-review channel, temporary nonresponse/change of channel, and no infinite presence are all retained in natural prose.

Read the entire paragraph: refusal remains possible without adding a separately derived legal right, admission precedes adoption but supplies a starting point rather than a reason, and the nonadopting branch remains coherent.
Read the entire paragraph: all three prohibitions remain and do not decide whether an actual exit has occurred; the unnatural substitution for facts is gone.

Read the entire paragraph: support for another's development is natural and does not suggest imposed cultural formation; this positive commitment remains unproved from the thin premises, with candid domination not refuted.
Read the entire paragraph: the book and the other person are explicit, and the book acquires no title to legislate in that person's place by describing the position.
Read the entire paragraph: the person refusing this proposal is natural and scoped; harm handled by external constructions and the four explicit textual supports remain.
Read the entire saved deck against Chinese: position présente correctly labels 今站; all listed cases and the no-condemnation boundary remain.
